title: Sr. Solutions Architect, Customer Lake
description:
FEQ327R42

Marketing teams are stuck between fragmented customer data and martech stacks that copy that data into proprietary silos while customers expect real-time, personalized experiences. Customer Lake , the agentic Customer Data Platform (CDP) built natively into Databricks, changes that equation. It unifies first- and third-party data into governed Customer 360 profiles, resolves identities, and uses agents to build audiences, recommend next-best actions, and activate campaigns across channels, all without copying data out of the Lakehouse or adding vendor lock-in.

The Solutions Architect (Customer Lake) team is part of a dedicated, global go-to-market organization focused on driving adoption and revenue growth for Customer Lake, Databricks’ agentic Customer Data Platform (CDP) built natively into the Data Intelligence Platform. The Customer Lake SA will engage clients across business units and verticals, build relationships with marketing and data stakeholders, position Customer Lake in depth, and deliver presentations, demos, and POCs that drive informed adoption decisions. They will understand the guardrails and the steps needed to successfully land and expand Customer Lake as clients deliver on their customer engagement and growth objectives.

 

The impact you will have

• Provide technical leadership to guide strategic customers to successful implementations on customer data and marketing projects, ranging from architectural design to data engineering to identity resolution, audience activation, and agent deployment

• Collaborate with GTM leadership and account teams to design and execute high-impact engagement strategies across your territory, driving Customer Lake adoption from initial Customer 360 build-out through full CDP augmentation or replacement.

• As a trusted advisor, serve as an expert Solutions Architect building technical credibility with CMOs, heads of marketing technology (MarTech), data engineering leaders, and marketing and analytics teams to drive product adoption and vision.

• Enable clients at scale through workshops, POC execution, and developing customer-facing collateral that increases technical knowledge and demonstrates the value of an embedded, agentic CDP architecture.

• Influence product roadmap by translating field-derived, data-driven insights into strategic recommendations for Product and Engineering teams.

• Handle the most complex technical challenges in this product line by acting as the tier-3 escalation point for the field, ensuring customer success in mission-critical, customer-facing data environments.

• Establish and refine the sales qualification and POC intake process, ensuring well-scoped engagements that maximize customer success and minimize friction for R&D.

• Build strong relationships with both internal and external business partners, contributing to broader goals and growth

• Drive thought leadership through mentoring and knowledge sharing

Competencies & Responsibilities

• 5+ years in a customer-facing, pre-sales, or consulting role influencing technical executives, driving high-level customer data and marketing strategy, and product adoption.

• Minimum 2+ years of experience implementing modern data estate, CDP, and Lakehouse architectures with a focus on data and AI applications.

• Experience with design and implementation of data and AI applications for marketing and customer engagement, including identity resolution, segmentation, personalization and next-best-action, and agentic AI workflows for audience building and campaign activation.

• Facilitate and influence Executive stakeholders while aligning technology strategy to business value and ROI

• Proficient in AI assisted programming, debugging, and problem-solving using SQL and Python.

• Experience collaborating with Global System Integrators (GSIs) and third-party consulting organizations to drive customer outcomes in marketing and customer data initiatives.

title: Implementation Specialist
description:
About Conductor :

Conductor is the leading enterprise AEO platform. Today’s top enterprise brands use Conductor to grow authority and visibility in both AI and traditional search engines. From tracking visibility in LLMs to real-time monitoring of technical site health and scaled AI content creation, Conductor provides a single source of truth that fuels digital growth-all from one platform.

Conductor is a mission-driven company with a commitment to innovation, customer success, and culture. For Conductor , success is improving the lives of everyone in our orbit-our customers, our customers' customers, our employee-owners, and our communities.

The Implementation Specialist is responsible for configuring and implementing Conductor solutions for enterprise customers during the onboarding stage of the customer lifecycle. This role ensures that customers begin their partnership with a well-structured account, reliable data, meaningful performance tracking, and a configuration aligned with their business priorities.

In the role, you’ll manage complex implementation projects involving account architecture, keyword and content strategy, AI Search Performance configuration, and analytics integrations. The role requires a combination of technical problem-solving, strategic thinking, project management, and customer communication.

Responsibilities

• Lead the onboarding implementation of enterprise customer accounts, ensuring that each account is configured accurately and aligns with the customer’s business objectives.

• Develop scalable account structures for complex enterprise organizations, including business units, product lines, geographic markets, audience segments, and other relevant reporting dimensions.

• Conduct and implement keyword research, keyword categorization, page groups, and competitive research within the Conductor platform.

• Configure AI Search Performance tracking, including the development and implementation of customer personas, topics, and prompts.

• Provide strategic guidance on persona development to ensure AI Search Performance tracking accurately reflects the customer’s audiences, business priorities, products, and services.

• Partner with customers to understand their search strategy, reporting needs, competitive landscape, and prioritized areas of the business.

• Configure, validate, troubleshoot, and develop solutions for customer analytics integrations, including Google Analytics 4 and Adobe Analytics.

• Investigate data discrepancies and integration issues, identify potential causes, and coordinate appropriate solutions with customers and internal teams.

• Maintain consistent communication with customers throughout the onboarding process, providing clear updates regarding implementation progress, outstanding requirements, risks, and next steps.

• Create and maintain implementation plans, progress-tracking resources, and supporting documentation that improve transparency and keep complex projects organized.

• Present research findings, account structure recommendations, and implementation strategies to customers and internal stakeholders.

• Manage multiple enterprise implementation projects simultaneously while maintaining accuracy, organization, and adherence to established timelines.

• Use artificial intelligence tools in day-to-day workflows to support research, data analysis, documentation, quality assurance, problem-solving, and process improvement.

• Review AI-generated work for accuracy, relevance, data quality, and alignment with customer requirements.

• Identify opportunities to improve, standardize, and automate implementation processes.

• Contribute to the development of internal documentation, best practices, training materials, and implementation standards.

• Support the onboarding and development of new team members by providing process guidance, training, and subject-matter expertise.

• Identify emerging customer needs, implementation challenges, and industry trends

description:
Stord is The Consumer Experience Company, powering seamless checkout through delivery for today's leading brands. Stord is rapidly growing and is on track to double our revenue in the next 18 months. To meet and exceed this target, Stord is strategically scaling teams across the entire company, and seeking energetic experts to help us achieve our mission.
By combining comprehensive commerce-enablement technology with high-volume fulfillment services, Stord provides brands a platform to compete with retail giants. Stord manages over $10 billion of commerce annually through its fulfillment, warehousing, transportation, and operator-built software suite including OMS, Pre- and Post-Purchase, and WMS platforms. Stord is leveling the playing field for all brands to deliver the best consumer experience at scale.
With Stord , brands can increase cart conversion, improve unit economics, and drive sustained customer loyalty. Stord ’s end-to-end commerce solutions combine best-in-class omnichannel fulfillment and shipping with leading technology to ensure fast shipping, reliable delivery promises, easy access to more channels, and improved margins on every order.
Hundreds of leading DTC and B2B companies like AG1, True Classic, Native, Seed Health, quip, goodr, Sundays for Dogs, and more trust Stord to deliver industry-leading consumer experiences on every order. Stord is headquartered in Atlanta with facilities across the United States, Canada, and Europe. Stord is backed by top-tier investors including Kleiner Perkins, Franklin Templeton, Founders Fund, Strike Capital, Baillie Gifford, and Salesforce Ventures.
Stord is building the operating system for modern supply chain - a unified platform handling Order Management, Warehouse Management, Transportation, and Consumer Experience for brands doing over $10B in commerce annually.

The MCP integrations, shared skill registries, harness engineering, and agent-ready infrastructure that turn individual experimentation into org-wide acceleration are not built yet. That is the job.

As an engineer on the Platform Services team, you are not building features for customers. You are building the system that determines how fast and how well every other Stord engineer can move. Your customers are internal. Your metrics are org-wide. Your leverage is higher than almost any other engineering role at the company.

You will operate with a high degree of agency. There is no backlog to execute against. You will identify what needs to be built, make the calls, and own the outcomes. If that requires external scaffolding to feel productive, this is the wrong role. If that sounds like the only way you would want to work, keep reading.
You will work alongside our Principal Engineering Group, who will provide architectural direction and roadmap prioritization. Your job is to translate that direction into working software, establish ownership patterns for shared services, and ensure product teams can integrate with your services reliably and with minimal friction.

We are looking for engineers who are smart, adaptable, and comfortable with adversity. The shared services space at Stord involves ambiguity-services that need ownership, technical direction that needs to be established, and integration patterns that need to be defined. If you thrive when given a hard problem and the autonomy to solve it, and you learn new technologies quickly when the situation demands it, this role is built for you.

We care more about your engineering fundamentals, problem-solving ability, and ownership mentality than checking every box on a technology list. Why This Role

title: Streaming News Writer
description:
​This is a paid freelance and remote position.
ScreenRant is the #1 entertainment website and publishes breaking news and exclusives on blockbuster movies, TV shows, comic books, and other forms of entertainment.
As a worldwide leader, ScreenRant operates at a rapid pace and is always looking for experienced and passionate contributors who can create original high-quality content in a timely manner.
Your Responsibilities:

• Write timely streaming news and streaming chart articles in ScreenRant 's house style (following the initial training period), optimized for Google Discover. This includes fact-checking, formatting, linking, and image sourcing/very basic editing (sizing, brightness, etc.)

• Track and quickly turn around coverage of streaming performance data - Netflix Top 10, Nielsen streaming rankings, FlixPatrol, and platform-reported viewership - translating charts and numbers into compelling, reader-friendly stories

• Monitor Netflix, Disney+, Max, Prime Video, Apple TV+, Hulu, Peacock, and other services for breaking news, new additions, leaving titles, renewals, cancellations, and trending viewership moments

• Craft Discover-optimized headlines and framing that capture reader curiosity and search intent without resorting to clickbait

• Update and refresh older content to keep it current as charts shift and titles move on and off platforms

• Accept and apply any/all feedback received by the editorial team

• Communicate openly and actively with the editorial team

• Flexible schedule, afternoon (PST) work schedule preferred, weekend availability valued

What We Offer:

• Competitive compensation.

• Consistent and timely payments.

• Flexible schedule.

• Remote freelance position to work from a location of your choice.

• Exposure to ScreenRant 's large and passionate audience, providing you an exciting opportunity to make a genuine impact.

Experience and Skills:

• Bachelor's Degree in Journalism, English Literature, or a related field

• Broad working knowledge of Movies and TV and the entertainment industry as a whole - across multiple genres

• Strong familiarity with the streaming landscape: the major platforms, their release strategies, and how streaming performance is measured and reported
• Experience interpreting streaming charts and viewership data is a strong plus

• An understanding of Google Discover and what drives engagement on the platform is a plus

• 2+ years of experience working with a credible digital publication

• A quick learner with a strong sense of urgency and drive

• An excellent writer in the English language free of grammatical and spelling errors

• The ability to write high quality articles with fast turnaround times

• Comfortable working in a fully remote environment

​
How to Apply:
If you are interested in this role, please send us the following documentation by uploading it in the relevant fields below:

• Your CV
We look forward to hearing from you!​
Our hiring team will review your application and contact you if we believe that your experience could be a match for this role.

Please note that a writing evaluation may be required as part of our application process.

ScreenRant is part of the Valnet Publishing Group.

​ ​​ ​ ​​​ ​ ​​ ​ ​​​​

Valnet , founded in 2012, is a global digital publishing and media investment Company that owns and operates over 25 authoritative brands across diverse verticals, including entertainment, sports, technology, automotive, gaming, lifestyle and travel.

Valnet is committed to producing premium content, and we therefore require all our contributors to adhere to our Editorial Standards, including a prohibition on using Artificial Intelligence.

title: Gainsight CS Operations Analyst
description:
Lone Wolf Technologies is transforming how we deliver Customer Success across a large and diverse customer base. As part of that transformation, we are implementing Gainsight CS, PX, and Skilljar to strengthen customer health management, digital engagement, adoption, and retention.

We are seeking an experienced Gainsight Administration / Operations expert to serve as the technical owner of the platform who will build the operational foundation for our future-state Customer Success model.

Reporting to the Vice President of Customer Success, this is a hands-on role for someone who has previously built, configured, and managed Gainsight in a complex SaaS environment. The ideal candidate brings deep technical expertise in Gainsight CS, strong Journey Orchestrator experience, and the ability to translate business requirements into scalable workflows, automation, reporting, and customer journeys.

ESSENTIAL RESPONSIBILITIES & DUTIES:

• Serve as the primary administrator and technical owner of Gainsight CS.

• Configure and maintain Gainsight objects, fields, layouts, permissions, health scores, CTAs, playbooks, Success Plans, reports, dashboards, and automation.

• Build and manage Journey Orchestrator programs, including audience criteria, branching logic, triggers, and automated communications.

• Partner with Customer Success leadership to translate customer journey and lifecycle strategies into scalable Gainsight workflows.

• Build and maintain Rules Engine configurations, data transformations, reporting logic, and automated customer health and risk signals.

• Partner with other system owners to integrate and operationalize customer data within Gainsight.

• Support the integration and use of Gainsight PX and Skilljar as part of broader digital adoption and customer education motions.

• Establish platform governance, documentation, testing, change management, and administration standards.

• Train and enable Customer Success users while continuously improving workflows and reducing administrative friction.

REQUIREMENTS:

• 3+ years of hands-on Gainsight administration experience in a production environment.

• Demonstrated experience building a Gainsight implementation, not simply using Gainsight as an end user.

• Deep hands-on experience with Journey Orchestrator, including building multi-step automated journeys, participant logic, and triggers.

• Strong experience with Rules Engine, Customer Health / Scorecards, Playbooks, Success Plans, Reports and Dashboards

• Experience working with Salesforce and understanding CRM data models, account structures, and integrations.

• Experience translating business requirements into scalable technical configurations.

• Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and data-management skills.

• Strong understanding of Customer Success workflows such as onboarding, adoption, risk management, retention, and lifecycle engagement.

• Preferred Qualifications

• Gainsight Administrator certification or equivalent demonstrated expertise.

• Experience with Gainsight PX and Skilljar

• Experience in a multi-product SaaS environment.

• Familiarity with SaaS metrics including ARR, GRR, NRR, churn, contraction, and product adoption.

About Antithesis

We build a platform that finds the bugs other testing approaches never see. Antithesis runs your entire system inside a deterministic simulation, breaks it in every way we can think of, and hands you a root cause with a perfect reproduction - no flaky tests, no false positives, no "works on my machine." Engineering teams debug faster and ship with far more confidence.

AI-generated code has made this work more urgent than ever. Agents write code faster than any human can, but faster code isn’t better code if it’s buggy, stuck in review, or quietly failing in production. The verification bottleneck is real, and it’s growing. That is precisely the problem Antithesis exists to solve. We’ve spent years quietly rethinking how the world approaches software reliability, and we’re just getting started.

title: Field Marketing Manager
description:
The way companies innovate is broken. The systems built to create and protect ideas can’t keep up with the pace of change. Today, 90% of S&P 500 company value is intangible (e.g., in intellectual property) - yet R&D and IP teams spend half their time buried in manual work, sifting through patents and paperwork instead of pushing the frontier forward. The tools of creating and protecting are stuck in the past. We’re here to fix that.

Ankar is building the R&D tools for the AI era and defining what applied research will look like in the next 20 years. We’re building infrastructure and product experiences our customers rely on every day. You’ll translate messy, ambiguous problems into clean, dependable software-and you’ll do it at the cutting-edge of AI.

We’re at an inflection point:

- We’ve raised >$24M to date from Tier-1 VCs like Atomico, Index Ventures, Norrsken, Daphni, and angels like the Founder of Hugging Face, CEO from Datadog, and Leaders from DeepMind and OpenAI.

- We’re already working with the world’s most innovative companies including Fortune 500 company L’Oréal and global law firm Vorys

- Expanding our world-class team with alumni from Palantir, Amazon, and BCG to tackle the $1T+ innovation market. We’re just getting started.

What you'll be doing

Own how Ankar shows up in the market - where we show up, what we do, and how we turn those moments into commercial outcomes. You’ll work closely with Sales and Commercial Development to build field programmes that create and accelerate pipeline.

- Own Field Marketing end-to-end. Lead everything from industry conferences and webinars to executive dinners, roundtables and targeted experiences.

- Build programmes around commercial priorities. Understand target accounts, active opportunities and pipeline gaps, and design programmes that create and accelerate demand.

- Partner deeply with Sales. Drive target account selection, outreach, meeting generation and fast follow-up around every programme.

- Build account-based experiences. Bring together events, gifting, direct outreach, digital and content to engage strategic accounts.

- Execute brilliantly. Own logistics, vendors, speakers, stakeholders and timelines across multiple programmes.

- Measure what matters. Track impact through account engagement, opportunities, deal progression, pipeline and revenue.

Qualifications

- 5+ years of experience in B2B field marketing, owning and executing programmes from events and webinars to targeted account-based experiences.

- Strong experience partnering with Sales to support target accounts, create pipeline and accelerate active opportunities.

- Highly autonomous and comfortable managing multiple programmes, stakeholders, vendors and deadlines end-to-end.

- Creative and commercially minded, with a strong bias towards action and measurable commercial outcomes.

- Excellent communicator, able to work effectively across Sales, Marketing, leadership and external partners.

Culture at Ankar:

Culture at Ankar is how we think, build, and operate. We’re building a generational company that redefines how the world’s best R&D teams create and protect ideas.

- Contrarian - We think from first principles: We think deeply, question assumptions, and build from first principles. The best ideas come from clarity and rigour.

- Creative - We build with taste: We’re building the R&D tools for the AI era and shaping what applied research looks like over the next 20 years. We care about precision, quality, and systems that last.

- Competitive - We play to win: We move with urgency and set a very high bar for ourselves and each other. Every win raises the bar. Every challenge sharpens us.

This role is not for you if...

- You need a highly structured environment, a predefined playbook, regular working hours, or a schedule that never requires travel. We operate with high autonomy and ownership, expect our team to go above and beyond, be obsessed with our mission and thrive in ambiguity

title: Phlebotomist Test Coordinator - Carmel, IN
description:
POSITION SUMMARY:

The Natera Test Coordinator plays a vital role in ensuring a seamless testing experience for patients. This position is responsible for scheduling and determining the most effective method for blood collection, preparing specimens for laboratory testing, and managing all necessary paperwork to ensure compliance.

In this role, you will work closely with customers and the sales team to facilitate an efficient ordering process and timely reporting of results. The ideal candidate thrives in an independent work environment, excels at multitasking, and demonstrates strong critical thinking skills to resolve issues promptly.

 

This is a clinic based position in Carmel, IN

Job offer is contingent upon pre-employment requirements for the assigned clinic.

 

PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES

PHLEBOTOMY SERVICES:

• Perform venipunctures to obtain blood specimens with precision and care.

•  Verify patient identity and test requisitions, ensuring accuracy by cross-referencing EMR records and resolving discrepancies.

• Maintain specimen integrity by following aseptic techniques, department protocols, and isolation procedures.

•  Accurately track collected specimens by documenting initials, date, and collection time, while maintaining daily collection logs.

PATIENT CARE COORDINATION:

• Oversee and coordinate patient care services to ensure efficient and high-quality healthcare delivery.

• Manage administrative tasks, including accessing patient records, scheduling appointments, and aligning blood draw times with clinic requirements.

• Collaborate with Field Sales and internal operations teams to provide patient support and ensure continuity of care.

•  Develop and maintain strong patient relationships to encourage ongoing testing and adherence to recommended care plans.

ADMINISTRATIVE AND OPERATIONAL MANAGEMENT:

• Act as the primary liaison for accounts and Sales, documenting all interactions, communications, and follow-ups.

• Respond promptly to internal and external customer inquiries, ensuring timely issue resolution.

• Build rapport with patients, accounts, and Sales teams to resolve missing information and maintain turnaround time (TAT) expectations.

• Proactively communicate delays and cancellations, facilitating timely sample redraws when necessary.

•  Investigate and resolve escalated issues, providing clear and logical explanations of root causes and resolutions through phone and electronic communications .

QUALITY ASSURANCE AND COMPLIANCE:

•  Ensure a safe and compliant work environment by adhering to CAP CLIA standards, legal regulations, and organizational policies.

• Maintain high-quality results by following department protocols, testing schedules, and recording outcomes in quality control logs.

• Monitor and report process improvement needs to enhance efficiency and accuracy.

•  Ensure compliance with federal, state, and local healthcare regulations, as well as internal operational guidelines.

QUALIFICATIONS

• Experience: Minimum 5-7 years of phlebotomy experience; oncology experience required.

• Education: BS/BA degree (preferred); High School Diploma (or equivalent) required.

• Certification: Phlebotomy Certificate (as required by state regulations).

EMPLOYMENT AND COMPLIANCE REQUIREMENTS 

• Employment is contingent upon successful completion of all pre-employment and clinic-specific compliance requirements, which may include, but are not limited to:

• Criminal background screening and employment verification

• Drug and alcohol screening

• Verification of licensure, certifications, and clinical competencies

• Immunization records and/or immunity titers

• TB testing and respiratory mask fit testing, if required

• Pre-employment physical examination, if applicable

• Completion of required compliance, safety, infection prevention, and facility   onboarding training

• Professional references and performance verification

title: Senior Systems Engineer (Identity and Access)

description:
At NewOrbit Space, our mission is to engineer the lowest orbiting satellites on Earth to rapidly advance global connectivity and insight.

We are currently building satellites that can operate at an altitude of just 200 km - one-third that of conventional satellites.

YOUR ROLE

We are seeking an experienced Commercial Lead to build and lead a high-performing commercial function that drives strategic customer relationships and secures high-value contracts with both government customers and large enterprises (primarily satellite primes and OEMs).

You'll own the path from shaping opportunities before tenders open, through leading competitive proposals, to securing multi-year contracts and driving sustained account growth. Your ability to navigate complex, high-stakes deals, foster a results-driven culture, and partner with our engineering and business teams will directly influence NewOrbit's market leadership.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

- Dual-market ownership (Gov & Enterprise): Build and execute account strategies for agencies and large companies; map stakeholders, budgets, and decision paths; shape requirements before tenders open.

- Tender intelligence & capture: Track pipelines across government portals and enterprise sourcing calendars; run capture plans, win themes, and competitor/price-to-win analyses; lead bid/no-bid decisions.

- Proposal leadership: Orchestrate compliant submissions; coordinate clarifications, BAFO, and oral presentations.

- Complex deal negotiation: Close supply, licensing, and co-development agreements; negotiate IP, warranties/liability, service levels, and milestone payments aligned to TRL gates.

- Partnerships & consortia: Structure teaming with primes, SMEs, universities, and test partners to strengthen bids and delivery confidence.

- Forecasting & governance: Maintain a transparent pipeline with stage gating, ACV/TCV, probability, and cycle metrics; report risks/mitigations and drive executive decision forums.

- Voice of customer: Feed market and procurement insights into roadmaps, qualification timelines, pricing, and make/buy decisions.

- Compliance & controls: Work with Legal/Compliance on export control (UK/EU/US regimes), information security, and public-sector procurement rules.

- Market presence & pitching: Represent NewOrbit at industry events, tender briefings, space conferences, and executive reviews; deliver compelling pitches and presentations that clearly communicate our vision and value proposition.

- Team leadership: Build, mentor, and inspire a high-performing commercial team, fostering persistence, creativity, and a results-driven culture.

FUNDAMENTAL REQUIREMENTS

- Space industry experience (required): Must have direct experience selling satellites or space hardware - payloads, cameras, antennas, subsystems. Candidates without space industry sales experience will not be considered.

- Experience: Minimum 5 years in business development or key accounts, with wins across government procurement and large-enterprise buying centres.

- Customer knowledge: Up to date on where satellite/space hardware customers are coming from today, across government, primes, and OEMs - not relying on outdated relationships.

- Full sales cycle ownership: Demonstrated experience across all stages - pre-tender shaping, capture planning, proposal/bid leadership, negotiation, and contract close.

- Tender mastery: Demonstrated success leading competitive bids (capture planning, scoring criteria, compliance, pricing) and handling long, multi-stakeholder cycles.

- Deal craft: Strong negotiation track record on MSAs/SOWs, licensing, co-development, and milestone-based contracts; fluent in IP and risk allocation.

- Domain fluency: Able to translate complex engineering (propulsion, LEO satellite platforms, qualification, test/readiness reviews) into customer value and business cases.

- Leadership & mentoring: Proven ability to recruit, develop, and manage high-performing commercial or sales teams.

title: Core Design Engineer
description:
Thanks for your interest in Oklo!  We are searching for a Core Design Engineer to join our engineering team.

Position Description

Core Design Engineers at Oklo are responsible for designing performant and manufacturable reactor cores which balance neutronic, thermal hydraulic, material, mechanical, and economic considerations. Work performed by Core Design Engineers includes executing multiphysics simulations to assess core performance, writing clear and thorough design documentation, performing analyses to validate and verify core requirements, and working closely with fabrication engineers to mature their designs.

Core design is an interdisciplinary field, we are looking for applicants who have a holistic understanding of reactor physics that lets them quickly ascertain how proposed design changes will impact core performance. Level will be determined based on applicant experience.

Specific responsibilities may include:

•
Traveling to headquarters (Santa Clara, CA) 2x per calendar quarter for team meetings, company offsite, or other business gatherings

•
Translating top-level stakeholder requirements into well-written system functional requirements

•
Modeling core performance over time through multiphysics simulations and first principles approaches

•
Documenting work using modern tools and techniques, and producing well-written technical reports

•
Collaborating cross-functionally to define performance requirements, and providing technical feedback to methods development teams

Minimum Qualifications:

•
Bachelors, Masters, or PhD in nuclear engineering or a related field

•
Experience with core design from a multidisciplinary perspective

•
Experience with object-oriented programming language (e.g., Python, C++)

•
Experience with neutronic analyses

•
Experience with thermal hydraulic analysis

•
Experience with material analysis

Bonus Qualifications:

•
Familiarity with principles of fast reactor core design

•
Experience with fuel cycle optimization

•
Familiarity/experience with ternary fuel and ternary fuel cycles

•
Experience with CI/CD computing environments

•
Experience with Monte Carlo neutronics tools (e.g., SERPENT, MCNP, SCALE, etc.)

•
Experience with deterministic neutronics tools (e.g., DIF3D, PERSENT, etc.)

•
Experience with reactor systems codes (e.g., SAS4A/SASSYS-1, SAM, RELAP, TRACE, GOTHIC, etc.)

•
Experience with fuel analysis and fuel performance software (e.g., BISON, LIFE-METAL, etc.)

•
Fluency in Python

Competencies

We are looking for a Core Design Engineer that is:

•
Passionate about clean energy 

•
An optimist at heart

•
Passionate about making advanced fission a reality

•
Willing and able to learn quickly

•
Willing to think differently and do things in new ways 

•
Comfortable in a fast-paced, highly iterative startup environment

•
Excited to think creatively, critically, and reflectively about the problems they are solving while not leaning only on what has been done before 

•
Willing to propose novel and creative solutions to technical problems

•
An excellent writer who can write in a modern active voice, so make your cover letter compelling and write it well!

•
Able to communicate technical content and results verbally

A startup person : You aren't driven by titles or hierarchy, and prefer efficiency to excess process. You don't need or expect to have a lot of guidance but you enjoy working in a fast-paced team. If you prefer the culture and feel of a large organization, that is great, but you likely won’t enjoy working with us! Anduril's Air & Missile Defense Radar team develops cutting-edge tracking algorithms and software systems that detect, track, and characterize airborne threats in real-time. Working in small, focused teams, our software engineers design and implement sophisticated tracking solutions that protect lives and critical assets. Our work spans the full spectrum-from developing novel multi-target tracking algorithms to building high-performance distributed systems that process massive amounts of sensor data in milliseconds

• Ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. Top Secret SCI security clearance

DESIRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Experience with tracking, estimation, or filtering algorithms (Kalman filters, particle filters, multiple hypothesis tracking, etc.)

• Background in controls, estimation theory, or digital signal processing

• Familiarity with radar systems or sensor fusion

• Experience with high-performance computing (multithreading, GPU acceleration, distributed systems)

• Knowledge of machine learning techniques for classification, clustering, or data association

• Proficiency with database technologies (SQL, NoSQL, time-series databases)

• Experience with web development technologies (JavaScript, React, Node.js) for building visualization and analysis tools

• Familiarity with modeling and simulation tools (MATLAB, Simulink, or custom frameworks)

• Experience working in agile development environments

• Active U.S. Top Secret SCI clearance

TeccWeb is an Epicor Service Partner comprised of a team of experts in Epicor ERP, Information Technology, Database Development, Program Customization, SSRS, Crystal Reports, Business Re-engineering and Employee Training providing enterprise resource planning (ERP) solutions to mid-market companies around the world.
Our experts come from a wide range of business backgrounds and are certified Epicor consultants. We offer a diverse skill set which enables us to provide our customers with the expertise needed to solve complex business issues successfully. Our success is derived from building strong, long term customer partnerships..
YOUR ROLE
As a TeccWeb Epicor Tools Developer, you are responsible for customizing, enhancing, and maintaining the Epicor Kinetic ERP system using native Epicor development tools. This role requires a strong blend of technical expertise, business process understanding, and problem-solving skills to meet specific organizational needs and optimize ERP functionality without altering core system code.
KEY RESPONSABILITIES AND COMPETENCIES

• Epicor Customization and Development

• Epicor Application Studio: Design and implement User Interface (UI) customizations for Kinetic web screens (adding/hiding fields, modifying controls, creating custom forms).

• Business Process Management (BPM): Develop and maintain server-side business logic using BPM Directives (Pre/Base/Post Processing) to enforce business rules and automate workflows.

• Proficiency in utilizing C# code within BPMs for complex logic is required.

• Epicor Functions: Create and manage reusable, encapsulated business logic components using Epicor Functions (written in C#) for specific, complex operations and integrations.

• Data Structure: Design and implement User Defined Tables (UDT) and fields to extend the Epicor data model as required by business needs.
Reporting, Data, and Integration

• Business Activity Queries (BAQ): Create, optimize, and maintain complex BAQs (including sub-queries and calculated fields) to support custom dashboards, reports, and integrations.

• Dashboards (EDD): Develop and customize Dashboards using BAQs and the Epicor Data Discovery (EDD) platform to provide users with actionable real-time data insights.

• Reporting: Design, develop, and modify financial and operational reports, often using SSRS (SQL Server Reporting Services) or other Epicor-supported reporting tools.

• Integration: Utilize Epicor's REST API and Service Connect (if applicable) to facilitate seamless data exchange and integration with external systems, ensuring all transactions respect Epicor's business objects.

TECHNICAL SILLS AND BEST PRACTICES

• Programming Languages: Strong proficiency in C# and familiarity with the .NET framework.

• Database: Solid working knowledge of SQL (T-SQL) for data querying and performance optimization.

• Troubleshooting: Ability to use Epicor and browser debugging tools (e.g., Application Studio debug console, F12 developer tools, tracing) to diagnose, troubleshoot, and resolve issues in customizations and BPMs.

• Best Practices: Adhere to best practices for Epicor development, including maintaining a clear separation between client-side (UI) and server-side (BPM) logic, and using Epicor services over direct database manipulation.

QUALIFICATIONS AND EXPERIENCE

• 5-10 years experience as IT Developer

• 5 years experience in ERP

• Last 2 years on Epicor Kinetic version

• Strong programming skills in C# and SQL

• Proven experience as an Epicor Developer, Consultant, or Analyst with a focus on customization and technical tools.

• Direct experience with Epicor Kinetic

• Recent version of Epicor 10 is a plus.

• Excellent analytical and communication skills to gather requirements and translate business needs into technical solutions.

• Experience in a manufacturing or distribution environment is a plus.

TeccWeb offers a very competitive salary and a benefit package including health, dental, disability an

As a Data Engineer, you will own the end-to-end lifecycle of data - from ingesting raw event streams and third-party feeds to building well-modelled, highly reliable datasets that power dashboards, predictive models, and customer journey orchestration. This is a high-impact, hands-on role where you will work at the intersection of product, analytics, and backend engineering. You will be expected to think beyond just moving data - designing for data quality, pipeline observability, cost efficiency, and long-term maintainability from day one.

Pipeline Development & Reliability

title: Revenue Operations Manager
description:
Revenue Operations Manager

📍 Manchester, UK (Hybrid, 2 days WFH) | 💰 Up to £70,000

Street Group is one of the fastest-growing PropTech companies in the UK. We aim to elevate UK estate agencies through world-class technology, creating exceptional experiences for everyone involved in buying, selling, renting and letting property.

Your job is to own the numbers for our entire commercial engine. You will build the single version of the truth that runs our marketing, sales and customer success functions, putting a reliable set of metrics in front of our leadership team and board.

You will take full accountability for the integrity of the commercial funnel, from top-of-funnel marketing right through to churn and renewals. Right now, each function applies its own definitions and rules. You will set a single, consistent framework and make it stick across the business. You will also take responsibility for forecasting, capacity planning and supporting the design of commission structures.

This is a hands-on position where you will own the tech stack with HubSpot at the centre. You will build the workflows, automation and permissions that keep data clean at source. You will also design systems alongside AI on a daily basis. We use Claude, and you will need to demonstrate how AI is already embedded into your workflow.

What you can expect to work on

- Building and maintaining complete visibility across the revenue line: marketing pipeline, sales pipeline, churn, renewals and capacity planning.

- Setting and enforcing a single set of definitions across marketing, sales and customer success.

- Owning HubSpot end-to-end: permissions, daily usage, workflow builds, automation and data hygiene processes.

- Producing forecasts, headcount plans and reporting that the leadership team can truly rely on.

- Contributing to the design of commission plans and commercial structures.

- Supporting the hiring and onboarding of a Sales Operations specialist, then training them to maintain what you have built.

- Presenting clean, consistent and defensible numbers to the board.

- Using AI to solve operational challenges that would otherwise require heavy manual work.

- Aligning the revenue line with the wider business (including product, finance and marketing) so everyone works from the same playbook.

Why you should (and shouldn't) apply

title: Contract - Senior Technical Recruiter
description:
Quantum computing holds the promise of humanity’s mastery over the natural world, but only if we can build a real quantum computer. PsiQuantum is on a mission to build the first real, useful quantum computers, capable of delivering the world-changing applications that the technology has long promised. We know that means we will need to build a system with roughly 1 million qubits that supports fault tolerant error correction within a scalable architecture, and a data center footprint.

By harnessing the laws of quantum physics, quantum computers can provide exponential performance increases over today’s most powerful supercomputers, offering the potential for extraordinary advances across a broad range of industries including climate, energy, healthcare, pharmaceuticals, finance, agriculture, transportation, materials design, and many more.

PsiQuantum has determined the fastest path to delivering a useful quantum computer, years earlier than the rest of the industry. Our architecture is based on silicon photonics which gives us the ability to produce our components at Tier-1 semiconductor fabs such as GlobalFoundries where we leverage high-volume semiconductor manufacturing processes, the same processes that are already producing billions of chips for telecom and consumer electronics applications. We also benefit from the quantum mechanics reality that photons don’t feel heat or electromagnetic interference, allowing us to take advantage of existing cryogenic cooling systems and industry standard fiber connectivity.

In 2024, PsiQuantum announced two government-funded projects to support the build-out of our first Quantum Data Centers and utility-scale quantum computers in Brisbane, Australia and Chicago, Illinois. Both projects are backed by nations that understand quantum computing’s potential impact and the need to scale this technology to unlock that potential. And we won’t just be building the hardware, but also the fault tolerant quantum applications that will provide industry-transforming results.

Quantum computing is not just an evolution of the decades-old advancement in compute power. It provides the key to mastering our future, not merely discovering it. The potential is enormous, and we have the plan to make it real. Come join us.

There’s much more work to be done and we are looking for exceptional talent to join us on this extraordinary journey!

description:

We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.

After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. 📍UK Remote | 💰£68,400 to £89,575 + Incentive Awards tied to your performance + Benefits ✨

⭐️ Our Ops Labs Team

We’re building Ops Labs: a small, high-impact team focused on incubating, testing and scaling new ideas that improve customer experience and create enterprise value for Monzo .

This role sits at the intersection of strategy, operations, data and experimentation. You’ll take ideas from concept to reality - rapidly testing hypotheses, learning what works (and what doesn’t), and turning the best ideas into scalable solutions across Operations.

Many of these ideas will come from our strategy work, customer insight, and experience gaps. Your job is to turn them into tangible experiments, validate their impact, and help scale the ones that meaningfully improve customer outcomes, reduce cost, or unlock new value.

This is a zero-to-one role. You’ll need to be comfortable operating with high ambiguity, building structure where none exists, and working hands-on to bring ideas to life.

🔑 You’ll play a key role by...

•
Turning ideas into real-world experiments - Take ideas emerging from strategy, customer insights, and experience gaps, and translate them into testable hypotheses. Design and execute experiments end-to-end - from scoping and setup to execution, measurement and readout - with a strong bias to action and speed.

•
Incubating high-potential opportunities - Identify and develop early-stage ideas that could significantly improve customer experience, reduce operational demand, or create commercial value. This could include rethinking service models, testing new ways to deliver support, or exploring entirely new capabilities within Ops.

•
Scaling successful experiments into production - Work closely with product, engineering, data science and operations teams to take successful pilots and scale them. Ensure there is a clear path from experiment → validated impact → operational or product integration.

•
Advancing goodwill and customer experience innovation - Reimagine how we deliver goodwill and recover from poor experiences - testing new approaches that improve customer trust while being sustainable and scalable. Push beyond incremental fixes to meaningfully raise the bar for customer experience.

•
Creating strong feedback loops with data science and CX insights - Partner closely with Customer Experience, Data Science and Insights teams to ensure experiments are informed by real customer pain points, and that we rigorously track the impact of changes (e.g. what actually improves CSAT, reduces complaints, or drives engagement).

•
Measuring impact and building the case for change - Define clear success metrics for experiments (CSAT, demand reduction, cost, engagement, etc.), track outcomes, and communicate results clearly. Build compelling cases to scale, iterate, or stop initiatives based on evidence.

•
Working hands-on with frontline operations (COps) - Collaborate closely with COps to test ideas in real environments. Use their feedback and expertise to refine experiments and ensure solutions are practical, scalable, and grounded in reality.

•
Pave the way for building a bigger experimentation engine

Founded in 2019, Uncapped is a leading fintech provider of working & growth capital to e-commerce companies in North America and Europe. We leverage multiple data sources and use cutting-edge models to make credit decisions faster and safer. We work with some of the largest global e-commerce platforms - including Amazon and Walmart - and strive to be the best alternative lender globally.
What will you do ✍️

• Run a high-velocity sales motion focused on US e-commerce SMBs

• Hit aggressive daily activity targets : dials, connects, deals worked, deals closed

• Own deals end-to-end on a short cycle - first call to closed-won in days, not months

• Work the phones hard. Telephony is the primary channel , supported by email, LinkedIn, and SMS cadences

• Hit inbound lead-response SLAs in minutes, not hours , and follow up with relentless cadence discipline

• Maintain pristine HubSpot hygiene - every call logged, every deal stage accurate, every next step booked

• Articulate Uncapped 's value to e-commerce founders quickly, handle objections in real time, and drive to a decision

• Compete on the leaderboard every week, every month, every quarter - and help your team win

• Partner with senior AEs and the credit team to push deals through diligence without losing velocity

How you'll be measured 📊

•
Activity : dials, connect rate, talk time, emails sent, sequences enrolled

•
Velocity : speed-to-lead, cycle length, time-in-stage, win-rate at each stage

•
SLAs : inbound response time, follow-up adherence, CRM hygiene

•
Winning : deals closed, revenue booked, quota attainment, leaderboard rank

Requirements

Who you are 👀
We care more about mindset and potential than experience. Here's what will set you apart:

• You’re ambitious and hungry to build a career in sales. You’re willing to put in the work, enjoy the challenge of winning, and are motivated to succeed in a quota-carrying role with the opportunity to earn commission.

• Strong communicator - you're confident on the phone, clear in writing, and know how to listen

• Organised and detail-oriented - you don't let things slip and you take ownership of your pipeline

• Coachable - you actively seek feedback and apply it quickly

• Competitive but collaborative - you want to win, and you want your team to win too

• Some exposure to a sales, customer-facing, or fast-paced commercial environment is a plus

• Fluency in English is required; additional languages are a bonus

Benefits
At Uncapped , our people make us successful. We're a start-up with big goals - we work hard, and we want to give everyone the benefits they really want. Some of what you can expect:

• Competitive base + uncapped commission - top performers earn meaningfully

• Unlimited holiday - well-rested people make the best closers

• MacBook

• Personal growth fund - raise your game from great to spectacular

• Monthly recognition and awards - celebrate wins big and small

• The opportunity to close deals every day with US e-commerce founders building real businesses

We can only consider applications from candidates eligible to work in the USA without requiring visa sponsorship.

Mobileye is looking for a passionate Systems Software Developer to join the Operating System Team in the EyeQ Platform Software Group. While many work on Linux, we work in Linux. The center of this role is the Linux userspace and the distribution itself: boot and service bring-up, root filesystem composition, and the integration of external SDK into that platform. Architect and develop Linux userspace and service bring-up so the distribution boots into a consistent, operational platform under embedded constraints.
Enable and integrate an SDK into the OS image - drivers, libraries, runtimes, and filesystem layout as first-class distribution components.
Own distribution composition, including packages, sysroots, and image features that make the SDK and core OS a maintainable, versioned platform.
Develop Python-based deployment tooling to provision targets with a reproducible OS + SDK environment (image delivery, flashing, and environment setup).
Debug at the OS boundary - init/service failures, library and ABI mismatches, missing dependencies, and SDK/runtime issues on the target.
Perform root cause analysis on system-level failures in the distribution, from boot and userspace bring-up through a fully operational stack.

Everpure (NYSE: P) has evolved from storage pioneer to data platform, closing fiscal 2026 with $3.7 billion in revenue, its first billion-dollar quarter, and accelerating growth into FY27. Our strategic agenda spans the companies defining the next era of technology - hyperscalers, AI labs, the AI hardware supply chain, data platform providers, and the broader AI ecosystem.

This type of work-work that changes the world-is what the tech industry was founded on. So, if you're ready to seize the endless opportunities and leave your mark, come join us.

THE ROLE

As the Director, Logistics and Trade Compliance, you will architect and safeguard Everpure’s global supply chain backbone across the US, Europe, and Asia. You will own end-to-end logistics performance, balancing cost, speed, and carrier accountability. You will serve as the critical operational bridge between regional execution and corporate Tax, Legal, and Compliance. In this role, you drive market expansion and entity readiness across volatile trade landscapes, ensuring logistics execution scales seamlessly with zero regulatory compliance risk.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

• Drive End-to-End Logistics & Spend Optimization: Lead regional logistics execution, network capacity planning, and mode design to exceed delivery commitments while driving cost-to-serve efficiencies across freight lanes, 3PLs, and carrier contracts.

• Manage Trade Compliance & Regulatory Risk: Execute compliant import/export, customs, and sanctions workflows; establish tariff mitigation frameworks and horizon-scanning mechanisms for high-volatility trade zones in tandem with corporate Tax and Compliance.

• Enable Global Market Expansion: Architect and deploy proactive IOR/EOR playbooks and multi-country entity readiness models to support expansion into high-complexity markets across LatAm and the Middle East.

• Strengthen Cross-Functional RACI & Governance: Partner with corporate Tax, Legal, Supply Planning, and Manufacturing to build a unified governance framework, aligning global policy with responsive regional execution.

• Scale Global Operations & KPI Analytics: Implement Lean processes, global trade management (GTM) tooling, and real-time dashboard analytics to monitor freight performance, supplier scorecards, and audit readiness.

WHAT YOU BRING

• Global Supply Chain Leadership: Expertise directing multi-regional logistics networks, freight forwarding, and 3PL performance management while optimizing freight spend at enterprise scale.

• International Trade & Entity Enablement Expertise: Deep operational knowledge of import/export regulations, customs classification, valuation, and IOR/EOR frameworks in high-complexity global markets.

• Strategic Cross-Functional Collaboration: Proven ability to partner with corporate Tax, Legal, and Compliance teams to mitigate tariff risks, establish clear RACI models, and translate regulatory policies into seamless operational execution.

• Data-Driven Performance Management: Command of supply chain analytics, KPI scorecards, and enterprise platforms (ERP/MRP/GTM, with SAP or SAP GTS preferred) to drive continuous improvement and end-to-end visibility.

title: District Director, NYC
description:

(NASDAQ: BKNG), is an industry leader with a passion for helping restaurants thrive. Our world-class technology empowers restaurants to focus on what matters most - their team, their guests, and their bottom line - while enabling diners to discover and book the perfect restaurant for every occasion. 

Every employee at OpenTable has a tangible impact on what we do and how we do it. You’ll also be part of a global team and its portfolio of metasearch brands. Hospitality is all about taking care of others, and it defines our culture.

About the Job

As the District Director for New York City, you will serve as the strategic territory leader for our largest and most competitive market in the United States. In this impactful role, you will drive revenue, customer growth, and retention by empowering a diverse team of account executives, account managers, and people leaders. You will act as a creative force to rethink strategies, challenge assumptions, and turn roadblocks into breakthroughs while navigating evolving customer needs. By rallying your team around bold targets and leading by example, you will build strong relationships with top customers and establish a standout brand presence in the market.

Responsibilities

• Drive revenue growth, customer acquisition, and account retention by executing comprehensive annual territory strategies and sales playbooks.

• Develop, mentor, and nurture a high-performing team of people leaders and ICs to consistently exceed monthly, quarterly, and annual sales goals.

• Engage actively in the NYC market by participating in customer meetings and industry events to build strong relationships with key accounts and prospects.

• Lead multiple high-priority initiatives independently, addressing performance gaps and fostering accountability, growth, and team collaboration.

• Represent the organization as an industry leader, maintaining an expert-level understanding of all products and trends to navigate complex customer conversations effectively.

• Utilize data and sales modeling to draw actionable insights, make data-led decisions, and adapt tactical plans to emerging industry trends.

• Serve as a key business partner to the executive team, representing the company’s interests and driving strategy for the high-stakes NYC market.

Minimum Qualifications

• 8+ years of sales leadership experience, with a proven track record of consistent success in a fast-paced technology, SaaS, or start-up environment.

• Demonstrated experience managing complex, high-value sales cycles with key or national accounts.

title: Senior Platform Engineer (Remote, Any Location, ES)
description:
Foundever ™ is a global leader in the customer experience (CX) industry. With 170,000 associates across the globe, we’re the team behind the best experiences for +750 of the world’s leading and digital-first brands. Our innovative CX solutions, technology and expertise are designed to support operational needs for our clients and deliver a seamless experience to customers in the moments that matter.
About the Role
We are looking for an experienced and pragmatic Senior Platform Engineerto join our Shared Services and Common Tools team. In this role, you will take direct technical ownership of our cloud-native observability ecosystem and core developer platform capabilities that support our internal engineering teams.
You will design, scale, and maintain and evolve our multi-tenant telemetry infrastructure while driving automated delivery pipelines and GitOps practices. Working alongside the Tech Lead, you will champion automated CI/CD workflows, declarative deployments, infrastructure as code, and AI-assisted development practices within an Agile/Scrum environment.
Key Responsibilities

• Design, operate, and scale our multi-tenant distributed observability stack (LGTM: Grafana, Loki, Tempo, Mimir) hosted on Kubernetes.

• Configure, tune, and maintain telemetry ingestion using Grafana Alloy (metrics scraping, log stream processing, and distributed tracing export via OTLP).

• Manage and reconcile application states and platform deployments declaratively using ArgoCD.

• Design, build, and optimize automated pipelines using GitLab CI/CD, defining reusable CI templates, testing stages, and deployment triggers.

• Automate and manage underlying cloud infrastructure, object storage, and Kubernetes resources using Terraform and Helm.

• Support shared platform services, including centralized IAM integration with Keycloak and developer onboarding via Backstage (Internal Developer Portal).

• Monitor platform health, manage high-cardinality telemetry data, configure retention/compactor rules, and establish alerting and SLOs.

• Leverage AI-assisted coding tools to accelerate platform development, documentation, and troubleshooting.

Mandatory Requirements

• 5+ years of experience in Platform Engineering, SRE, or DevOps roles.

• Extensive production experience running, troubleshooting, scaling, and maintaining workloads, StatefulSets, and DaemonSets.

• Hands-on LGTM Observability Stack Experience:

•

• Demonstrated proficiency operating and querying Loki (LogQL) and Mimir / Prometheus (PromQL).

• Working experience with distributed tracing via Tempo (OpenTelemetry standards).

• Direct experience with modern telemetry collectors, specifically Grafana Alloy(or OpenTelemetry Collector / Promtail).

• Clear understanding of high cardinality, multi-tenancy, and object storage lifecycles for metrics and logs.

• Proven experience deploying, configuring, and managing multi-cluster applications declaratively using ArgoCD (ApplicationSets, sync policies, and rollback strategies).

• Proven ability to build robust .gitlab-ci.yml pipelines, configure custom runners, and structure CI stages for containerized platform tooling.

• Proficiency writing modular Terraform and packaging applications with Helm.

• Active, hands-on experience leveraging AI-assisted development tools (e.g., Claude Code, Cursor, or GitHub Copilot) to streamline coding, debugging, and automation tasks.

• Strong automation skills inBash, Python, or Go.

• Professional working proficiency in English (written and verbal).

Nice-to-Have

• Experience collaborating on software supply chain security initiatives, including vulnerability tracking and SBOM governance using tools such as Dependency-Track.

• Experience with Backstage service catalogs and software templates.

• Familiarity with Keycloak administration, OIDC/OAuth2 concepts, and realm configurations.

What We Offer

• Direct ownership over foundational observability and delivery systems powering enterprise-scale

title: Senior Software Engineer (Python, Typescript) - Full Stack
description:
The Short Version: We aren’t building software to sell ads or optimize clicks. At Augintel , we build Natural Language Processing (NLP) software that helps social workers and clinicians read through mountains of messy case notes to find critical, life-saving information about kids and families.

Our tool can help a social worker understand a thousand-page case history in seconds. Because of our software, caseworkers are finding lost grandmothers so kids don't go to foster care, uncovering hidden risks, and quickly spotting if a child urgently needs diabetes medication.
We are a small, tight-knit team of five, and we need a Senior Software Engineer to help us build the infrastructure that makes this all possible.

What You Will Actually Do Here: We need you to build the heavy-lifting software around the AI. You will be working closely with a Machine Learning expert.

•
The Heavy Lifting (70%): The biggest chunk of your work will be building the engine that extracts insights from notes and indexes them for downstream consumers (APIs, our web app). This will entail designing and building pipelines that process millions of case notes reliably and at scale. This backend work is heavily driven by Python .

•
The Infrastructure: You will be configuring and using AWS (specifically ECS, OpenSearch, Lambda, and S3) and writing solid SQL (we use PostgreSQL).

•
The Web App (30%): The remaining portion of your work will involve the front-end user interface and APIs, where you will use TypeScript (React and NodeJS).

Who You Are:

•
You have 5+ years of real-world experience. We are looking for someone who is solidly mid-level (your second or third real job). You aren't an entry-level beginner, but you also aren't looking to be a hands-off architect or on a fast track to management. You just want to write great code and improve your craft.

•
You are independent. We are a remote team. We need someone who can work on their couch, figure things out, and know when to raise their hand for help without flailing.

•
You like talking to people. You will occasionally jump on video calls directly with our clients to troubleshoot issues, stand up new features, or whiteboard solutions. We don't want someone who just wants to sit in a dark closet and write code.

•
You want ownership. You won't just be blindly pulling widgets off a backlog. You will collaborate daily with our ML researcher, product manager, and clients to frame problems and design actual solutions.

The Perks:

• 100% Remote (US-based). If you happen to be in the Chicago area, great-we have a local nexus here-but it is absolutely not required.

• Get hands-on experience working right alongside cutting-edge Machine Learning and NLP technology.

• Go to sleep every night knowing your code is actively keeping kids safe and giving social workers their time back.

If you are a solid Python, Typescript and AWS developer who wants to use your powers for good, we want to talk to you.
